privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is our top priority. This document explains how we protect your data.
privacy.collectionDesc: We do not collect IP addresses, exact geolocation without permission, or device metadata that could identify you.
privacy.usageDesc: Information provided in the report is used exclusively for internal investigation purposes.
privacy.securityDesc: We use military-grade encryption to ensure your reports remain anonymous.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using AnonProtect, you agree to the platform's ethical use guidelines.
terms.responsibilityDesc: The user is responsible for the veracity of the reported information.
terms.prohibitionsDesc: It is forbidden to use the platform for slanderous reports or pranks.
terms.anonymityDesc: The system guarantees non-tracking of the report origin on the server side.

transparency.label: Transparency
transparency.anonymityLayerDesc: Our architecture uses layered routing that prevents administrators from seeing the connection origin.
transparency.zeroLogsDesc: We do not keep access logs that contain network information from users.
transparency.independentAuditDesc: The anonymity engine's source code is reviewed periodically to ensure integrity.
